feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 November 2026 10:15am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 20 November 2026 at 10:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the English Channel, with high pressure near Greenland.


##Wind##

Northeast 3 or 4, becoming variable 3 or less this afternoon, settling east or southeast 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate in the south at first, soon falling smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then a risk of mist or fog patches near the coastlines in the southeast of the area (e.g. Liverpool Bay) overnight and at first tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Mostly good. Risk of poor or very poor in the southeast of the area.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow evening, then 6 or 7 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate, then moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair but with a risk of mist or fog in the southeast of the area at first.


##Visibility##

Mostly good. Risk of poor or very poor near the coastlines in the southeast of the area at first on Saturday and again later.
